slides.title: A category of their own
slides.text: Online-only friends can be real fun and real company. They are still a category of their own: people you have never met in real life do not get real-life-friend information.
slides.alt: A game chat from NewFriend with clues marked: “I can send you a rare game skin, free” and “keep this our secret.”

focus.cue: An online-only friend: kind words first

slides.title: Screenshots escape
slides.text: Group chats feel private because the door looks closed. It is not. One screenshot carries any message out of the chat and into the whole school, forever out of your control.
slides.alt: A group chat with clues marked: “Everyone is doing it. Post the photo or you are out of the group” and “do not show any adult this chat.”

focus.cue: Do not show any adult: a warning sign

slides.title: Their photo, their yes
slides.text: A photo of someone else is their image, not your content. Posting it needs their yes, every time. The same respect covers their private facts, their location and their bad days.
slides.alt: A group chat with three clues marked: “Post that funny photo of Sam asleep on the bus!”, “He will never know.” and “Everyone will laugh.”

focus.cue: A dare to post a friend's photo, without their yes
"He will never know": he never said yes

slides.title: Location is a live fact
slides.text: Location sharing shows where you are while you are there. Check who can see it, and turn it off when nobody needs it. A live location is the most private fact a screen can carry.
slides.alt: Would you rather: an app that is free if it sees where you are, or an app that costs a little and never knows?

focus.cue: Free, if it sees where you are, live
Costs a little, and never knows

slides.title: Pressure is not friendship
slides.text: A chat friend dares you to share your location and prove you trust them. A Defender names what is happening before answering.
steps: The dare is pressure, not friendship
Trust never needs a live location as proof
Refuse, leave the chat, or block
Tell a trusted adult if it continues
slides.alt: The debrief: that is the move! Pressure dressed up as friendship. Behind this one: the vandal, who wants damage and a big reaction.

slides.title: Leaving is allowed
slides.text: Pressure and dares have one clean answer: leaving is allowed, always. A friend who punishes you for leaving has told you what the friendship was worth to them.
slides.alt: The moves for NewFriend's chat: Deliver, Bin it, Show Pim, Report & block.

focus.cue: Leaving and blocking are always allowed

words.means: a clear yes from the person a photo or fact belongs to
describing a friend you know only through a screen
where someone is, shown by a device
pushing someone to do what they do not want to do

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Open Trick Inbox at Ask First and sort all 6 messages. Judge each one by consent, not by popularity.
slides.alt: A post from Video Star Contest with both clues marked: “for the whole world to see” and “No need to ask them first!”

focus.cue: Play Ask First: judge by consent, not popularity
